appearance_facts.fact: A blue line connects data points for each year from 2005 to 2014.
Each data point is a black circle with its temperature value labeled above it.

public_definitions: Review the regional summer temperature dashboard for the 2005-2014 review period, determine whether the full-period change requires substantial-change follow-up, then submit the appropriate routing decision.
Use the dashboard to determine whether the full-period regional summer temperature change should enter substantial-change follow-up or remain in routine monitoring.
